attchmntText: Naga Dhunseri Group Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Naga Dhunseri Group Limited has authorized three Key Managerial Personnel to determine the materiality of events and make disclosures to the stock exchange. This action was taken by the Board of Directors during a meeting held on 13th November 2026. The designated individuals are Mr. Chandra Kumar Dhanuka, serving as Chairman and Director; Mr. Sudarshan Mall, serving as Chief Financial Officer; and Ms. Sakshi Agarwal, serving as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The company filed this disclosure under Regulation 30(5) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Naga Dhunseri Group Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Un-audited (Standalone & Consolidated) Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Naga Dhunseri Group Limited disclosed un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 13th November 2026. Standalone profit for the half year was 672.77 Lakhs, compared to a loss of 1,088.02 Lakhs in the previous year. Standalone total income for the half year was 783.23 Lakhs. Standalone total assets as at 30th September 2026 stood at 40,703.17 Lakhs. The statutory auditors, Dhandhania & Associates, issued a review report stating no material misstatements were identified. The company operates in the Treasury Operations segment. Financial results are available on the company website.
